name: uyushmachilar
description: Uyushmachilar — O'zbekistondagi transport uyushmachilari uchun ko'p kompaniyali SaaS platforma

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker,bot -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @uyushma/api" "npm run dev -w @uyushma/web" "npm run dev -w @uyushma/worker" "npm run dev -w @uyushma/bot"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @uyushma/api && npm run build -w @uyushma/web && npm run build -w @uyushma/worker && npm run build -w @uyushma/bot
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio minio-init
